findings_and_relationships.status: conditional source-level missing-observation finding; supported producer and global alias pending
findings_and_relationships.first_contract: When a selected terrain report requires a foot-ground observation, unavailable required sample(s) must remain unavailable rather than be treated as a measured zero clearance or zero terrain relief.
source_trace: Current capture/root_motion.rs 18–47 samples each mapped bone position; with CaptureGround::Terrain an absent valid-coordinate terrain.height_at becomes BoneSample.terrain_clearance_metres=None. Current scene/queries.rs 61–68,86–89,106–125 shows height_at is optional and out-of-grid points can return None, while required_height_at explicitly distinguishes MissingSupport.

Current report/metrics.rs 1155–1182 skips feet with missing bones or clearances, then emits 0.0 when no finite relief survives; partial missing samples are omitted. The computed value is retained by scenario_metrics 201–239 and report/model.rs 152.

Current report/metrics.rs 966–1007 and 1010–1044 skip missing required contact/toe clearances and return (0,0) or 0 when none survive; actual support selection and independently required-IK guard still apply.

Current report/acceptance_limits.rs 140–159 adds relief to the terrain vertical bound; validation.rs 67–94,444–454,492–493 compares these scalars. With missing relevant observations, 0.0 can satisfy the individual nonpenetration threshold and can be used as if it were measured flat relief.

report/mod.rs 102–110 requires planned frame/bone presence and report/model.rs 291–297 tests finite bone positions and rotations, but neither of these checks proves present terrain clearance; other independent validation, artifacts, rig, scheduling and geometry gates still apply.
findings_and_relationships.conditions: A supported selected terrain scenario must supply a captured finite required foot/toe role whose terrain footprint query returns no surface (e.g. an out-of-grid foot while its root remains admitted), or a required contact observation has no applicable samples. No such supported ordinary capture, exact footprint, full accepted report, native rendering or runtime outcome has been observed. If only some observations are missing, the source silently computes over the available subset; no direction of bias is assumed. Disabled IK/authored-plane and legitimately nonapplicable flight/contact must remain distinct.
findings_and_relationships.historical_relationship: 059 q1216, q1231 and q1236 explicitly left terrain optionality, missing geometry and current report gates open; q562/q565 request related current owners. P17 SEGOVB-INITIAL04-CONTRACT-586 and CONT07-CONTRACT-566 describe separate historical typed observation behavior, corroborated in P17 clearance.rs 47–89,138–163 and acceptance_limits.rs 24–46. Do not assume exact alias or historical current proof; central reviewer determines ledger identity.
findings_and_relationships.future_repair_direction: First establish the owning required observation/selected scenario policy and an actually supported missing-footprint producer, then keep measured/unavailable/nonapplicable distinct through metric and expected-bound construction. Preserve optional no-IK, no-contact and authored-plane semantics and all independent report gates. Only after separate implementation/product-validation authorization, acceptance should distinguish a missing applicable foot clearance from a genuine measured zero and show valid off-mode behavior.

lens_notes.producer_propagation: Terrain surface query -> optional per-bone clearance -> metric reduction -> scenario bound and terrain penetration checks. P17 explicitly carries unavailable observations; current code collapses some missing samples to zero. The actual supported missing-clearance producer and final report policy remain open.
lens_notes.type_ownership: Scenario metadata owns applicability; ExpectedScenarioBounds P17 owns typed expected thresholds separately from measured observations. CaptureSequence and native App own diagnostic lifetime; do not promote P17 types into current baseline by byte comparison.
lens_notes.type_granularity: In P17 ExpectedVisualHeight binds min, max and peak count; current returns an Option tuple. Observation measured/unavailable/not-applicable are distinct from scalar zero. UnitInterval, HeightDistance and NonnegativeLength serve distinct semantics when actually owned by their snapshot.
lens_notes.admission_contracts: P17 constructs checked length bounds and adjusted SignedLength before use; current foot values are raw fixed f32 and scenario distances are computed without equivalent local readmission. Actual finite supported plan inputs and all aggregate admissions remain to be traced.
lens_notes.invariant_operations: Current foot relief folds only available samples and uses zero for no finite extrema; contact/toe minima also use zero on no finite samples. P17 preserves explicit unavailable. Arithmetic overflow and native float semantics outside source-supported cases remain conditional.
lens_notes.enum_shapes: Optional scenario selection, armor, body proportions, terrain and hidden window are deliberate modes. Missing terrain observation during an applicable terrain check must be distinguished from legitimate no-contact or nonapplicable scenarios before a repair shape is chosen.
lens_notes.aggregate_states: A valid report binds requested plan, frames, every required bone and applicable physical observations; bone presence and finite transforms alone do not prove per-bone ground clearance. Multiple gate booleans represent independent validation obligations, not necessarily one exclusive state.
lens_notes.magic_numbers: Distance and angle margins are scenario-specific authored review policies, many annotated against 64 Hz captures. Fixed test-derived numbers are not runtime measurement evidence; selected alternate sample rate and threshold calibration are a connected policy question, not an automatic arbitrary-type defect.
lens_notes.magic_strings: CaptureOptions scenario is a native CLI String converted into ScenarioMetadata before plan creation; empty selection assertion remains existing q46. Native output path/title and diagnostic messages are boundary values; unknown labels or output prose need actual producer policy.
lens_notes.existing_type_owners: Existing P17 NonnegativeLength, HeightDistance and Observation demonstrate possible owners in that snapshot. At 95e decide actual required measurement boundaries and current type APIs first; do not restore the historical branch or introduce wrappers for every local constant.
lens_notes.redundant_authority: Authored scenario thresholds and observed gait/ground ranges are expected and measured roles, not duplicated gameplay authority. Expected plan and retained capture frames jointly validate selection; optional empty cadence helper is not by itself an accepted incomplete report.
lens_notes.behavior_preservation: Keep valid no-IK authored-plane, no-flight, ragdoll, special transition and scenario-specific gates while preventing absent required observations from masquerading as measurements. Preserve exact selected-plan validation and error provenance; no threshold weakening assumed.
lens_notes.derivability: Existing Serialize/Debug derives and named structs supply native report protocol shapes. No unneeded manual trait implementation or automatic serialization substitution established in bounded bodies.
